rules.title: Sonoma County Library Policy 8001 — Photography and Filming
rules.summary: The policy addresses interior and exterior filming, objections by subjects, operational interference, meeting-room filming, and advance authorization for professional/commercial projects. Its scope and constitutional validity are not presumed from adoption.
open_questions: How are subject objections, paid social-media content, professional projects, media notice, and exterior boundaries interpreted?
What branch-specific directives and enforcement records exist?
How do the cited statutes actually apply to the recorded subject and communication?

cpra_targets.target: Healdsburg-specific filming/conduct signage, implementation guidance, and current incorporated meeting-room and exclusion rules, after reviewing public policy sources.
cpra_targets.why: The photography policy is available; the remaining gap is its local application and incorporated terms.
